title: External WLU admission boundary
summary: Terminal Machine consumes external Work Load Unit authority. Admission happens before each mutation; terminal-native meter facts describe work while WLU policy owns normalization, capacity and settlement.
invariants: Do not implement a private Terminal Work Unit economy.
Capacity/admission failure must leave terminal mutation count unchanged.
WLU reservation settlement or invalidation makes subsequent mutation fail.
Crypto and WLU remain external dependencies.

provenance.claim: Supports this Terminal Machine/TN5250 continuity article.
